# Status of PAN – Protean
**Option I Track on basis of Acknowledgement Number**
  1. Visit **<https://tin.tin.proteantech.in/pantan/StatusTrack.html>**
  2. Select " PAN-New/Change Request" from drop-down menu in "Application Type" option.
  3. Enter your Acknowledgement Number and click on "Submit" button

[Click here](https://tin.tin.proteantech.in/pantan/StatusTrack.html) to Know the Status of PAN application - Protean
